evidence.quote: If you are a non-EU citizen residing abroad, you must submit a pre-enrolment application to request an entry visa for study purposes in order to enter Italy.
You must submit the pre-enrolment application on the Universitaly platform (www.universitaly.it)

value.quotedAs: High-school diploma (for enrollment in Bachelor's Degree programmes)

evidence.quote: Mandatory documents to be uploaded during pre-enrollment procedures on Universitaly: Passport Photo Admission letter (if provided) High-school diploma (for enrollment in Bachelor's Degree programmes) / Bachelor's Degree + Transcript of exams (for enrollment in Master's Degree programmes)
Final high-school diploma in original. High-school report cards.
Translations must always be made in compliance with the rules established by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)

notes: Tuition left out: the pages only give an ISEE-band table and a fee simulator, not one amount for a full-time non-EU applicant living abroad (https://www-2023.studenti.uniroma2.it/it_it/simulatore-calcolo-tasse-e-contributi/ and the 2021/22 thesis-mobility band's ISEE table). The programme's own page (economia.uniroma2.it) is a 2018 Dual Degree news item and states no duration, language, tuition, intake or document list for this Bachelor. No language proficiency rule for an entrance requirement was found; only a general admission-language statement (Italian B2) tied to Italian-taught degrees. Deadline rule for Universitaly (July 31) is stated for the general non-EU pre-enrolment route; the pre-enrolment route is a visa step, not an application to this programme.

evidence.quote: The qualification must be obtained at the end of a school period equal to at least 12 years of schooling

note.fr: Vérifiez le bando/avviso du programme pour les éventuelles procédures d'admission et les échéances applicables aux étudiants internationaux.
note.en: Check the programme's bando/avviso for any admission procedures and deadlines applicable to international students.

evidence.quote: Per i corsi di studio erogati in lingua italiana, i candidati in possesso di un titolo di studio estero devono seguire le modalità indicate nel bando o nell'avviso di ammissione del corso di studi prescelto.

note.fr: Un test d'admission ou une évaluation peut être exigé : consultez le bando du cours pour les procédures et les échéances.
note.en: An admission test or assessment may be required: check the programme's bando for procedures and deadlines.

evidence.quote: Per i corsi di studio dove è prevista l'iscrizione al test di ammissione o valutazione puoi consultare tutte le informazioni sulle procedure e le scadenze sui relativi bandi o avvisi

note.fr: La préinscription sur Universitaly doit être faite avant le 31 juillet (sauf programmes avec test d'entrée, où elle précède le test).
note.en: Universitaly pre-enrolment must be submitted by 31 July (except for programmes with an entrance exam, where it precedes the test).

evidence.quote: The deadline to submit UniversItaly pre-enrollment is July 31 except for programs that require entrance exam, in that case the pre-enrollment must be submitted before the test.
